exposure: Elective cesarean section under general anesthesia
outcome: Neonatal Apgar score at 1 and 5 minutes
cohort: The study included 7,131 patients who underwent elective cesarean section under general anesthesia at Melinda Women Hospital Bandung Indonesia between July 2004 and June 2022.
finding: No association was found between general anesthesia in cesarean section and low Apgar scores in neonates.
